chapter.subject: Social Science
source_key_points: 3 CHAPTER Empires and Kingdoms: 6th to 10th Centuries India never spoke her last word.
The Shore Temple at Māmallapuram, built during the reign of Narasimhavarman II of the Pallava dynasty.
How did the political, cultural, and religious developments shape India during this period?
What was the impact of foreign invasions and interactions on Indian society and polity during this period?
This chapter and the next together survey the scene in India from the end of the Gupta era about 600 CE to about 1200 CE.
These six centuries together have received several names — ‘post-classical’, ‘late classical’ and ‘early medieval’ among others.
We need not use any of those terms here, as long as we keep the broad chronology in mind.

In Grade 8, we will explore the next centuries, leading up to the colonial era, dominated by British Exploring Society: India and Beyond | Grade 7 Part 2 rule in India, and, ultimately, the struggle for freedom from the colonial rule, culminating in India’s independence.
The mighty Gupta Empire (see the chapter on the ‘Gupta Era’ in Part 1 of this textbook) has lost its dominance.
You are a young traveller setting off on an adventure across the subcontinent.
